verdict_reason: Matches the spec (code headings, scientific name alone) but adds a fourth home for the species display rule beside species-name.js and species-latin-name.js.

todos.issue: How a species is shown now has four homes: speciesLabelFor here (identity on the Latin name), speciesLatinNameOf in check-answers/view-model/cards/consignment/species/species-latin-name.js (also imported by animal-identification/card/view-model.js), an inline entry.speciesLatinName in consignment-details/view-model/groups.js:6, and commodities/species-name.js speciesName (commonName ?? speciesLatinName), which states a contradicting rule for consignment-details/selected-rows.js and animal-identification/summary/selected-commodities.js. The spec now says a species is shown by its scientific name alone; changing that again means finding every copy.
todos.fix: Must: one function owns how a species is labelled on the live-animals journey, and the search results, the selected summary, commodity details, animal identification and check answers all call it; no page reads speciesLatinName or commonName directly for display. One way: make commodities/species-name.js the owner (returning the Latin name, as the spec states), import it from search/view-model and the other features, and delete labels.js speciesLabelFor and species-latin-name.js.
